snippet.title: Sanatorium Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The year is 1923 — you must infiltrate Castle Woods Sanatorium, where care and cruelty blur together. Disguise yourself as a doctor, where you’ll diagnose and treat patients using a deck of symptoms, tests, and outdated therapies. But tread carefully: one wrong move could expose you as an impostor which could lead to disaster for you.

Releasing on Steam November 6, 2025!
